date.as_written: saṃraṣṭau ṛṣibhiḥ cāṣṭau śrāvane (!) śukladvādaśī | ... saṃvat 878 miti śrāvanaśukladvādaśī (!)

notes: The date is given both in chronogram (aṣṭau [8], ṛṣibhiḥ [7], aṣṭau [8] = 878) and in numerals (saṃvat 878). No human agents (scribe, patron, king, or author) are named in this colophon.
